verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

translations.text: Woe to those who give less [than due],

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

translations.text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

verses.transliteration: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon

translations.text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day -
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen

translations.text: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Who deny the Day of Recompense.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

translations.text: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

translations.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

translations.text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon

translations.text: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

translations.text: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

translations.text: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing.
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

verses.text_uthmani: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.transliteration: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon

translations.text: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
And its mixture is of Tasneem,
A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

translations.text: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

translations.text: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon

translations.text: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

translations.text: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
On adorned couches, observing.

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon

translations.text: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
